# Medicare levy variation declaration ## Who should complete this form ### Claiming an exemption or varying the amount withheld - You have to pay the Medicare levy surcharge and want to increase the amount withheld from payments to you to cover the surcharge (for more information, see [Question 4](https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/medicare-levy-variation-declaration#question4)). ## How to complete the form – payee ### Section A: Payee's declaration #### Question 4 – Do you want your payer to increase the amounts withheld from you to cover the Medicare levy surcharge (MLS)? - you are either - single, have no dependants and your income for surcharge purposes is more than $97,000 - a member of a family that has a combined income for surcharge purposes of $194,000 or more. The family income threshold is increased by $1,500 for each MLS dependent child after the first child. | Income threshold | Rate | |-|-| | Tier 1
$97,001 – $113,000 | 1% | | Tier 2
$113,001 – $151,000 | 1.25% | | Tier 3
$151,001 or more | 1.5% | | Income threshold | Rate | |-|-| | Tier 1
$194,001 – $226,000 | 1% | | Tier 2
$226,001 – $302,000 | 1.25% | | Tier 3
$302,001 or more | 1.5% |

They can lodge a _Medicare levy variation declaration_, asking you to increase the amount to be withheld from their payments.
